Copia,
Durchlauchtigster Fürst!
gnädigster Fürst und Herr!
Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht ermangle ich nicht
untertänigst anzuzeigen, daß Sr Majestät auf den
Vortrag Höchstdero Schreibens vom 21ten d. M.
zu befehlen geruhet haben, daß die Beantwor¬
tung desselben, wie Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht
selbst zu erwarten schienen, biß zur Einkunfft des von
dem Etats Minister v. Voss erforderten Berichts aus¬
gesetzt bleiben solle. Ich verharre mit der
tiefsten Ehrerbietung
Euer Hochfürstlichen Durchlaucht
Berlin
den 25ten Januar 1799.

translation.en:
100

Copy. Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! I do not fail most humbly to inform Your Most Serene Highness that His Majesty, upon the presentation of Your Highness's letter of the 21st of this month, has been pleased to command that the answer thereto shall, as Your Most Serene Highness yourself seemed to expect, remain deferred until the arrival of the report required from the Minister of State v. Voss. I remain with the deepest reverence Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin

the 25th of January 1799.

most humble and obedient servant

Beyme

Copy. Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! I do not fail most humbly to inform Your Most Serene Highness that His Majesty, upon the presentation of Your Highness's letter of the 21st of this month, has been pleased to command that the answer thereto shall, as Your Most Serene Highness yourself seemed to expect, remain deferred until the arrival of the report required from the Minister of State v. Voss. I remain with the deepest reverence Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin

the 25th of January 1799.

most humble and obedient servant

Beyme
summary_en: Copy. Beyme informs the Prince that, after his letter of the 21st of this month was presented, His Majesty has ordered that the reply to it be held back until the report arrives that the Minister of State v. Voss is to supply. According to Beyme, the Prince himself seemed to expect this.
summary_de: Abschrift. Beyme teilt dem Fürsten mit, dass Sr Majestät nach dem Vortrag seines Schreibens vom 21. d. M. befohlen hat, die Antwort darauf bis zum Eingang des Berichts zurückzustellen, den der Etats Minister v. Voss liefern soll. Der Fürst habe dies nach Beymes Worten selbst zu erwarten geschienen.

reading.notes: Copy of a short note from Cabinets Rath Beyme to the Prince. He reports that the King has considered the Prince's letter of the 21st of this month and ordered that the answer wait until a report requested from Etats Minister v. Voss has come in. The text is sound. It has nothing to do with Trąbczyn. From the context this is probably the Krotoszyn matter, but the letter does not say so, so it stays out of the summary.

claims.statement: Der König hat nach dem Vortrag des fürstlichen Schreibens vom 21. d. M. befohlen, die Antwort bis zum Eingang des von v. Voss erforderten Berichts auszusetzen.
Der Fürst hat dies nach Beymes Worten selbst erwartet.
claims.why: Lines 9-10 say 'wie Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht selbst zu erwarten schienen': the prince only seemed to expect it. The letter does not say he expected it for certain.
